thread:
elaine: Alert from SIEM: multiple KMS Decrypt calls tied to backup CMK from an unusual IP range. Found ciphertext stored in archival S3. marking as potential credential leak.
sam: path? i'll pull S3 access logs + KMS CloudTrail entries.
elaine: s3://redwood-archive/retained_backups/2023-12/agent_state.kms.enc
elaine: initial ask: deny decrypt, rotate CMK/alias, and rewrap via Vault transit. we should also remove partner service grants until verified.
kyle: agree. recommend immediate deny on key policy for the partner principal and add conditional deny for non-member IP ranges. i'll draft the IAM change.
ops-oncall: blocking decrypt via key policy update now. writes to the prefix are frozen. enabling object-level logging and forwarding to secure-audit.
sam: CloudTrail shows 6 Decrypt events in the last 48h. source principal: partner-ingest-role and a stale ci-runner role. i've exported events to the incident bucket.
sec-bot: matched playbook: "keystore-incident-v1". suggested flow: 1) emergency key policy deny 2) create replacement CMK and alias 3) create new Vault transit key and rewrap artifacts 4) rotate service principals 5) audit-forwarding + SIEM tuning.
elaine: kyle please own CMK rotation; sam own log export and timeline; tasha (tagged in DM) own Vault rewrap and policy. ops-oncall coordinate maintenance window.
kyle: creating infra PR to create new CMK and swap alias. will schedule key rotation and set pending window for 15m to re-encrypt. PR link when ready.
ops-oncall: maintenance scheduled 02:00 UTC for 15m. posting in #deployments. rollback plan in place.
sam: timeline: first Decrypt at 2025-02-10T03:12Z by partner-ingest-role; subsequent calls 03:18Z and 03:22Z. correlating IPs with partner CIDR.
svc-partner: partner-ingest-role here — we've paused our ingest jobs and will hand over any audit logs we have. happy to collaborate.
elaine: until we validate, partner ingress is revoked for the transit key. prep short notice for partner about access suspension.
sam: found an old CI token in the object metadata; rotating all tokens issued before 2025-01-01. starting churn for ci-runner fleet.
tasha: Vault steps: create transit key backup-v3, run transit/rewrap for affected ciphertexts, and revoke old key ACL for partner. example command:
```
vault write -f transit/keys/backup-v3
vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@agent_state.kms.enc key=backup-v3
```
ops-oncall: tested restore flow against a sample artifact using backup-v3; success. keeping old key disabled and scheduling scheduled-destroy after 30 days per retention.
kyle: infra PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/901 — creates CMK, swaps alias, updates key policy to deny partner principal.
elaine: enabling high-priority vault audit stream to SIEM and setting rule to auto-open a ticket on any decrypt by non-admin.
sec-bot: checklist: CMK swap: in-progress; Vault rewrap: in-progress; service principal rotation: in-progress; SIEM rule: in-progress.
ops-oncall: CI roles rotated; pipelines rekeyed; scheduled maintenance completed.
sam: log timeline compiled and saved to incident-docs; no evidence of external exfil beyond partner's CIDR calls but keeping posture conservative.
elaine: drafting customer/partner comms: "We detected activity involving an archived, encrypted backup. Keys and access were rotated and constrained. No confirmed data exfiltration. We'll share follow-up after postmortem." saving to incident-docs.
svc-partner: provided our access logs and rotated our ingest creds. thanks for the quick coordination.
elaine: final: please confirm when your assigned item is done in-thread. i'll run a post-incident RBAC audit next week and file follow-ups.
ops-oncall: all infra steps completed and artifacts rewrapped.
kyle: PR merged; CMK alias swapped; key policy tightened.
tasha: Vault rewrap completed; partner grant removed; audit-hook in SIEM active.
sec-bot: scheduled follow-ups: RBAC audit, KMS policy hardening, credential churn report, postmortem.
elaine: closing coordination. creating postmortem ticket and assigning remediation owners. :thumbsup:
